mr-mime-future-sight.name: Future Sight
mr-mime-future-sight.description: Bond skill: a foreseen psychic blast at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 100).

mr-mime-barrier.name: Barrier
mr-mime-barrier.description: Bond skill: mimes a wall up to 2 hexes away; allies in a 1-hex area are Fortified 2 turns.

mr-mime-swift.name: Swift
mr-mime-swift.description: Bond skill: star-shaped rays at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60).

mr-mime-psywave.name: Psywave
mr-mime-psywave.description: New skill: an odd psychic wave at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 55).

mr-mime-encore.name: Encore
mr-mime-encore.description: New skill: makes a foe up to 2 hexes away repeat itself; it can't move for 1 turn.

mr-mime-psychic-focus.name: Psychic Focus
mr-mime-psychic-focus.description: Its Psychic moves deal 15% more damage.

mr-mime-invisible-wall.name: Invisible Wall
mr-mime-invisible-wall.description: Foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 8 damage: they bump into its wall.

mr-mime-substitute.name: Substitute
mr-mime-substitute.description: New skill: leaves a decoy to take the hits; it is Protected for 2 turns.

mr-mime-psyshock.name: Psyshock
mr-mime-psyshock.description: New skill: a psychic wave at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70).

mr-mime-mimes-act.name: Mime's Act
mr-mime-mimes-act.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

mr-mime-vanishing-act.name: Vanishing Act
mr-mime-vanishing-act.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

mr-mime-nasty-plot.name: Nasty Plot
mr-mime-nasty-plot.description: New skill: plots something wicked and becomes Focused for 2 turns.

mr-mime-extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
mr-mime-extrasensory.description: New skill: an eerie psychic force at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95).

mr-mime-unbreakable-act.name: Unbreakable Act
mr-mime-unbreakable-act.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

mr-mime-showstopper.name: Showstopper
mr-mime-showstopper.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes carrying a status an ally applied.

mr-mime-hyper-voice.name: Hyper Voice
mr-mime-hyper-voice.description: New skill: a booming shout at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90); Exposes it 1 turn.

mr-mime-light-screen.name: Light Screen
mr-mime-light-screen.description: New skill: mimes a wall of light; it and adjacent allies are Protected for 1 turn.

mr-mime-mind-bulwark.name: Mind Bulwark
mr-mime-mind-bulwark.description: Takes 25% less damage while at full HP.

mr-mime-applause.name: Applause
mr-mime-applause.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes with any status.

mr-mime-grand-performance.name: Grand Performance
mr-mime-grand-performance.description: Capstone. Its non-damaging skills recharge 1 turn faster; each combo it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

mr-mime-invisible-stage.name: Invisible Stage
mr-mime-invisible-stage.description: Capstone. Its ranged moves fire over Pokémon in the way; 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

mr-mime-insomnia.name: Insomnia
mr-mime-insomnia.description: Never stops performing: cannot be put to Sleep, Paralysed or Slowed.
